purpose: T94: formalize the funding-sign regime conditioning discovered in T89. T89 showed the hourly funding_pct signal exists only in positive-funding regimes (Jul-Aug ~87% positive funding) and halves/loses FDR when negative-funding months are added (Apr-Jun 44-50% positive). The daily-scale spec research/financial_signal_spec_v1.json gates on BTC trend; this task measures whether a funding-sign regime gate is the conditioning variable at hourly scale, and cross-checks the same gate on the daily cohort. Measurement only — no fitting, no trading, no profitability claims.

hourly.label: label.forward_return_bps (4h forward mark move, bps, gross)

daily.label: 5d forward mark log return computed from features.mark_price (same construction as financial_signal_regime_v1 / labels_v4)

regime_definition.rule: At each record, share_pos = fraction of the trailing window with last_funding_rate > 0 (window EXCLUDES the current record; zeros count as non-positive). regime = positive if share_pos > 0.6, negative if share_pos < 0.4, mixed otherwise.
regime_definition.daily_cells: primary split is positive (share>0.6) vs non-positive (share<=0.6, i.e. mixed+negative pooled); the 3-way split is reported as detail

arms.R1_coverage: regime cell counts per asset and monthly positive-funding share (context tying to the T89 observation)
arms.R2_hourly_spearman_by_regime: funding_pct (trailing-90-record mid-rank pct of last_funding_rate, per asset) -> 4h fwd bps Spearman WITHIN each regime cell (positive/mixed/negative). Question: does rho live only in the positive regime?
arms.R3_hourly_f2b2_by_regime: hourly f2b2 analog: arm = funding_pct>=0.80 AND basis_pct>=0.66 (trailing-90 pcts); Welch mean-diff of 4h fwd bps, arm vs rest, within each regime cell
arms.R4_daily_crosscheck: daily cohort, per-asset trailing-180 sign share; funding_pct (trailing-180 mid-rank pct) -> 5d log(mark) Spearman within positive vs non-positive regime (3-way split as detail). Question: is the daily funding-follow signal also positive-regime-specific?

statistics.spearman: mid-rank Spearman rho, normal-approx t/p (project convention, same as financial_signal_intraday_v1); min n=10
statistics.welch: Welch two-sample t on mean fwd bps, normal-approx two-sided p; min n=10 per side
statistics.multiple_testing: BH-FDR alpha=0.05 per family: {R2: 3 cells}, {R3: 3 contrasts}, {R4: 2 cells} — families not pooled across arms
caveats: 4h forward labels on 1h bars overlap ~4x and 5d labels on 1d bars overlap ~5x -> positive autocorrelation; p-values nominal/optimistic
regime and funding_pct share the same trailing funding window -> regime membership is mechanically correlated with the score; the split is a conditioning measurement, not an independent gate
BNBUSDT daily carries last_funding_rate=0 on ~56% of records across the full span; zeros count as non-positive share, so BNB never enters the positive regime
daily non-positive cell pools mixed+negative -> smaller n and heterogeneous composition; 3-way detail reported for transparency
